title: Download headers use the report words, as Sales by Customer does
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 4 S4-R6 Reports Story 3 S3-R4)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Use a staging client with two locations, and pick both in the Location filter in step 2.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick both locations in the Location filter.
  3. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
  4. Click Download Expanded View (CSV) in the ⋯ menu.
  5. Open Reports › Sales By Customer.
  6. Click Sales By Customer's expanded CSV download.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • Both locations are picked.

Step 3:

  • Tier A's row shows customer A's $121.50.

Step 4:

  • The CSV headers read Priced By, Customer, Invoice #, Date, Location, Priced For, Parts Cost, Parts Invoiced, Parts Credits, Parts Net, Parts Margin, Parts Margin % and % of Total.
  • The Totals row is labelled "Totals".

Step 5:

  • Sales By Customer opens.

Step 6:

  • Customer, Invoice #, Date, Location, Parts Invoiced and Parts Margin are spelled the same, letter for letter, in both downloads.
